case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1421 OF 2015; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1470 OF 2017; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) Nos. 6134-6135 of 2019)
summary: Appeal challenging conviction under IPC s.302/149; contention: absence from contemporaneous documents including merg/inquest/spot panchnamas; FIR delay (8.5 hours); witnesses inconsistent/interested; moonlight visibility improbable during power cut; accused No.11's injuries unsatisfied; prosecution reliance on rustic witnesses; standard: whether membership in unlawful assembly sufficient without individual acts; medical evidence confirmed homicidal death and injuries.
final_judgment: Appeal details indicate partial abatement due to death/sentence completion; judgment text truncated but implied remand or acquittal based on procedural defects in prosecution evidence.
